test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of these statements is NOT true?

options.text: The deal will enable Air India to compete with rivals
The negotiations between parties went on for years.
Air India has agreed to acquire around 500 jets from airbus and Boeing
The talks resulted in signing of the largest deal by an airline.

solution:
The correct answer is** "The negotiations between parties went on for years."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage specifies that the deal between Air India and Airbus/ Boeing was in preparation for "over a year" and not "years". 
 
• The serious conversations started last summer and continued until days before Christmas when outlines were agreed.
 
• Therefore, it's incorrect to say the negotiations went on for years, as no specifics beyond over a year are mentioned in the passage.
 
• The other statements are accurate as per the passage. The deal will enable Air India to compete with rivals, Air India has agreed to acquire around 500 jets from Airbus and Boeing, and the talks resulted in the signing of the largest deal by an airline.

**Hence, the correct answer is 'Option 2'.**
